title: Check: Effect of Temperature on Rate (2)

questions.stem: Why does refrigerating food help it last longer?

options.text: The cold temperature kills all bacteria completely
Lower temperature slows down the chemical reactions that cause food to decompose
The food becomes frozen solid and cannot react
Refrigerators remove all oxygen, preventing reactions

questions.explanation: At lower temperatures, particles have less kinetic energy and move more slowly. Fewer collisions occur and fewer of those collisions have enough energy to overcome the activation energy. This slows down the decomposition reactions that cause food to spoil.

questions.stem: How does the Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution curve change when the temperature increases?

options.text: The peak gets higher and shifts to the left
The curve stays exactly the same shape
The peak gets lower and the curve shifts to the right, spreading out
The curve becomes narrower with a higher peak

questions.explanation: At higher temperatures, the Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution curve flattens and shifts to the right. The peak is lower and broader, meaning more particles have higher energies. The total area under the curve remains the same (same number of particles), but a much larger proportion now exceeds the activation energy.
